description: List iOffice mail items (packages and letters). Supports filtering and pagination.

endDate.description: Filter mail received on or before this date (ISO 8601)

search.description: Filter by recipient name, tracking number, or sender

startDate.description: Filter mail received on or after this date (ISO 8601)

status.description: Filter by status (e.g. received, delivered, returned)

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns iOffice's payload untouched. No field projection: this server has no verified record of which iOffice fields matter, and inventing one would risk dropping a field a caller needs.

name: io_list_mail
